LanguageData.HR_BronzeAxe.label: Bronze axe
LanguageData.HR_BronzeAxe.description: A wooden-handled tool with a bronze head. When equipped, it can cut ancient trees.
LanguageData.HR_IronAxe.label: Iron axe
LanguageData.HR_IronAxe.description: A wooden-handled early iron tool. It cuts ancient trees more efficiently than a bronze axe.
LanguageData.HR_TreeResin.label: Natural tree resin
LanguageData.HR_TreeResin.description: Natural resin collected from ancient conifers, suitable for adhesive, water-resistant treatments, and craft materials.
LanguageData.HR_DenseHeartwood.label: Dense heartwood
LanguageData.HR_DenseHeartwood.description: Hard, close-grained heartwood for fine woodworking and durable objects.
LanguageData.HR_RareWoodBurl.label: Rare wood burl
LanguageData.HR_RareWoodBurl.description: A dense growth on a tree trunk, useful for carving, decoration, and trade.
LanguageData.HR_MedicinalFungi.label: Forest medicinal fungi
LanguageData.HR_MedicinalFungi.description: Medicinal fungal raw material gathered from ancient-tree habitats. It does not directly treat serious disease while unprocessed.
LanguageData.HR_FragrantWood.label: Fragrant wood
LanguageData.HR_FragrantWood.description: Wood with a persistent scent, useful for crafts and trade.
LanguageData.HR_ToughBastFiber.label: Tough bast fiber
LanguageData.HR_ToughBastFiber.description: Strong plant fiber taken from bark for cordage and weaving materials.
